purpose: 汇总39盲审、19最终取舍与9任务；不是可刷机认证。本文编写只读原资料和Git，未构建或访问路由器。
evidence_rules: source_only不记为已运行；预测base失败不记为实际失败。
Rust单测、exact C函数oracle、注入故障、stock daemon wire和硬件验收分别标注。
保留既有合同的测试允许base通过；这不是产品修复的base-fail证据。
引用旧实测不代表本轮重跑；有界拒绝不表示穷尽证明无缺陷。
映射是内容归组；squash后的group_commit不要求原commit成为祖先。
19旧待定结案与额外源码意见、发布验收是否完成是不同字段。

tasks_9.topic: DNS TCP65536与DHCP重复选项（合并为原第4任务）

subdecisions.reason: The 65530-byte upstream frame can expand to the internal 65536 boundary. Base closes the client connection before emitting a frame, remains alive and handles the following 65535 control. No daemon panic/abort or illegal client frame was observed, so the stricter hardening criterion is not met. C itself emits a zero-length prefix followed by payload at the expansion boundary.

For OFFER, ACK and rapid-commit with configured 51/53/54/80 plus encap:54, base emits no reply, remains healthy and exits normally. Its existing InvalidOption encoder rejection prevents illegal mandatory-option duplication. C emits duplicate mandatory options; C behavior is not a reason to make Rust send invalid packets.
